question: Jyotiba Phule founded the Satyashodhak Samaj (Truth Seekers’ Society) in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1873.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jyotiba Phule **founded the** Satyashodhak Samaj** in **1873.**
 
• Satyashodhak Samaj was founded with the aim of **liberating the lower castes** from the **oppression **of the **upper castes** in Hindu society.
 
• Jyotiba Phule was a **social reformer **who played a crucial role in the **upliftment** of the** lower castes and women **in **Maharashtra.**
 
• He also founded the **first school for girls** in **Pune in 1848** and was a strong advocate for **women's education.**
 
• **Option 1** (1852) and **Option 4** (1865) are** incorrect **as Jyotiba Phule founded Satyashodhak Samaj in 1873.
 
• **Option 3** (1898) is also** incorrect **as Jyotiba Phule passed away in **1890.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jyotiba Phule** was born in **1827** in **Maharashtra, India** and belonged to a **lower caste.**
 
• He was a strong critic of the **caste system **and **Brahminical patriarchy **in Hindu society.
 
• **Option 1 **(1852) is close to the actual year of **Jyotiba Phule's first social work**, where he opened a **school for the untouchables **in Pune, but it is not the year he founded Satyashodhak Samaj.
 
• **Option 4 **(1865) is also close to the year when Jyotiba Phule started the** Satyashodhak movement,** but it is not the year when he founded Satyashodhak Samaj.
 
• Hence, the **correct answer** is **option 2 (1873).**
